name: lightningmate
description: Self-hosted management dashboard & autopilot for an Umbrel LND Lightning node (fees, rebalancing, channels, Amboss Magma liquidity)

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.check:api-types: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w web && node --import tsx --test web/test/apiContract.test.tsx

comment:overrides: Patched transitive deps that the lightning library's own ranges would let through - as ranges, so a later fix is taken too: @grpc/grpc-js ^1.14.6 (GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j and GHSA-f596-whhp-79r4: fixed in 1.14.5; GHSA-5375-pq7m-f5r2 and GHSA-99f4-grh7-6pcq: fixed in 1.14.4), bn.js ^5.2.3 (GHSA-378v-28hj-76wf, an infinite loop: fixed in 5.2.3). Drop each once lightning's ranges exclude the vulnerable versions; CI runs npm audit on the production dependencies.
